email.subject: Gear up
email.body:
Perfect, Thanks for your help. I'll take that as more than enough proof that you're the right one for this. What's coming up is going to be a lot harder - so I'm gearing you up.
I've attached a link to one of my drop servers, with admin login details for it. On it, in the /bin/ folder, you'll find a few new programs. They're not the sort of thing I want just drifting around the web, so you're only getting them now because I'm out of options - and you've proven you can help.
While you're going to need to get all of them, "Sequencer" is especially important - it's something I wrote a long time ago to help time things between multiple hackers anonymously, but i've re-purposed this build for you. I'll explain what it does when you've got everything downloaded and ready.
The other two are port crackers - SMTPOverflow floods an SMTP (mail server) port - usually #25. SQL_MemCorrupt is an injection attack on an SQL server - they default to port 1433.
Make sure you pick up everything, --Bit 0
